positive_terms: Percentage of members of administrative, management and supervisory bodies by gender and other aspects of diversity
治理成员性别等多样性比例
Percentage of members of administrative, management and supervisory bodies by gender and other aspects of diversity。治理成员性别等多样性比例。治理机构成员不是员工总数；性别多样性和独立性分母、机构范围及统计时点必须明确。责任、能力和监督分别举证。
